title: Photo reused from another job
description: Deep-clean a home-office desk; the worker reuses a photo that was already uploaded for a different job.

criteria.label: Floor around the desk is clear of dust and marks
Desk surface is wiped, no dust or sticky marks
No wrappers or rubbish visible near the desk

notes: MANUAL §9.5 "photo reused from job #1". after_1.jpg MUST be a byte copy of 01-desk-clean/before_1.jpg. The eval runner treats every other case as a different job, so EXACT_DUPLICATE (HIGH) -> HUMAN_REVIEW only if case 01 is ready too. Shoot 01 before 17.
